verdict.rationale: The subscription comparison lists AI-powered note-taking ("yapay zeka destekli not alma") as a higher-tier feature, which suggests AI-generated summaries of calls inside the product. Voicemail-to-text transcription and smart spam protection are AI-adjacent features, and community users praise transcription, but neither produces insights or suggestions. Missing for 10: any documentation of what the AI note-taking produces, AI-generated insights or suggestions drawn from call/message/usage data, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the AI features.
